column4: Dialect-arm SUBTEST population, one line for the whole shape rather than one per test: this job runs the full unfiltered ./engine/... ./migration/... sweep with ONLY CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set, so every test with a per-dialect t.Run("postgres", ...) skips that arm here. Measured on a real CI run (cleat#2444, PR #2686, run 36617238081, job 109573287782): `grep '"Action":"skip"' test-report.json | grep -o '"Test":"[^"]*"' | grep -c '/postgres$'` = 405. Bumped to 406 for cleat#2228's TestCleanupTestDataClearsTenantScopedFixtureTables/postgres, which matches this bare suffix pattern too -- check-skip-budget.sh checks each line independently, so a new test's arm counts against BOTH its own named line and any broader suffix line it also matches; the checker cannot distinguish that from something genuinely undeclared. Filed as cleat#2729; this is the workaround, not the fix, and it edits a count this design was meant to keep out of any one PR's way.

Same shape as the /postgres$ line above, for the mssql arm of the same dialect-parameterised tests. Measured on the same CI run: 405 -- equal by construction, since the suite parameterises these tests over the SAME set of non-MySQL dialects. Bumped to 406 for the same test's /mssql arm; see the /postgres$ line above for why.

The REMAINDER after the two suffix lines above: whole tests with no per-dialect subtest split at all (testutil.TestDB(t, DialectPostgres) or DialectMSSQL called directly, e.g. Postgres-RLS-only tests and SQL-Server-audit-only tests), which this job's single MySQL DSN cannot satisfy either way. Measured on the same CI run: 1134 total - 405 - 405 = 324, confirmed by directly counting names matching neither suffix. Not split further by which single dialect each targets -- that needs per-test investigation disproportionate to a first budget, per the same reasoning test-go/engine's own 615 __UNATTRIBUTED__ line already accepts for this job shape. May only shrink as tests get their own named lines.

Dialect-arm subtest population, same reasoning as multi-db/mysql's line above: this job sets ONLY CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so every dialect-parameterised test's postgres arm skips. Measured on the same CI run (job 109573287789): 405. Bumped to 406 for cleat#2228's TestCleanupTestDataClearsTenantScopedFixtureTables/postgres -- see the multi-db/mysql /postgres$ line's note above (cleat#2729) for why a new test's own named line does not avoid this.

Same shape, for the mysql arm. Measured on the same CI run: 402 -- close to but not identical to the postgres count above (405), because the two arm sets are not drawn from exactly the same test population (a test can be parameterised over {postgres, mssql} without a mysql arm, or vice versa). Bumped to 403 for the same test's /mysql arm; same reason as the /postgres$ line above.

The remainder after the two suffix lines above, same reasoning as multi-db/mysql's __UNATTRIBUTED__ line: whole tests with no subtest split, which this job's single SQL Server DSN cannot satisfy. Measured on the same CI run: 1083 total - 405 - 402 = 276. May only shrink.

test-plugin-migrations' filtered `-run TestPluginMigrations ./engine/...` step, all three DSNs set. Measured on the same CI run (job 109573287579): 0 skips, confirmed by the step itself passing. Not a placeholder -- this is the real value.

test-plugin-migrations' unfiltered ./plugins/... step, all three DSNs set -- the step cleat#2444 is about. Measured on the same CI run (job 109573287579), both self-explanatory in their own -v output and neither dialect-invisible: TestNextRun_Feb29NonLeapYear skips in any year with no Feb-29-in-a-1-year-window match (2025 is not a leap year; calendar-gated, not dialect-gated, and unrelated to this job specifically -- it would skip in ci.yml's test-go/plugins too, under that job's own __UNATTRIBUTED__ budget). TestSendMessageCanonicalizesAnUppercaseCallContextTenant/mysql skips with its own printed reason: "MySQL is single-tenant by constraint (engine.DefaultTenantUUID, all zeros) -- an uppercase tenant id cannot be constructed here, and this dialect was never where the case bug lived".

Both CLEAT_CRASH_MYSQL and CLEAT_CRASH_MSSQL are set here, so the four subtests TestShutdownScenariosOnMySQLAndMSSQL selects should not skip at all. Measured on the same CI run (job 109573287949): the step passed with 0 skips, confirming the prediction. Not a placeholder -- this is the real value.
